root_cause: Multiple agents can pass exact-head CI while protected main advances. Existing hourly Janitor reads open PRs and compares them to moving main ref, but lacks a single immutable-epoch advisory summarizing where canonical writers may need to refresh after checking branch protection.
failed_approaches: Treat green CI on stale SHA as proof of mergeability
Compare many open PRs against a ref that may change mid-sweep without recording an epoch
Rerun or force-rebase unrelated active agents rather than keeping one owner
fix: Pin existing Janitor GitHub compare GETs to GITHUB_SHA and publish a read-only bounded advisory matching the exact open-PR snapshot, immutable main epoch, head SHA, behind/ahead counts and canonical obligation grouping. Contradictory/missing proofs suppress advice. Retired/draft/contained candidates excluded. No new API reads, scheduler, CI dispatch, merge, or change to protected checks.
prevention_rule: Never promote stale-main PRs or interpret behind/green as authorized automatically refreshed. Confirm exact head checks, current-main epoch, nonoverlapping changes and a single writer lease before any existing coordinator reconciles the branch. Missing evidence or contradictory compare status requires WITHHELD state. Keep merge_group branch protections if merge queue is ever configured.

invariants: full open PR identity and head match or no advice
only existing hourly Janitor and already fetched snapshots
never triggers new CI, branch updates or merge

terminal_rule: Source status live only after exact-head Required/CodeQL, protected merge, exact-main source readback, existing Janitor post-merge artifact and skill projection; no throughput speedup inferred.
